metadata.title: Moment obstructions and continuum-to-discrete bounds for checkerboard no-three-in-line sets
metadata.abstract: Fix one colour class in the checkerboard colouring of an $n\times n$ integer grid, and let $M_4(n,\varepsilon)$ be the largest subset having at most two points in every row, column, and diagonal of slopes $\pm1$. We prove the near-saturation bound $M_4(n,\varepsilon)\leq2n-4$ for $n\geq6$. The proof uses first and second moments of the four line families: a hypothetical set of size $2n-3$ produces row, column, and diagonal deficits whose exact moment identities contradict Cauchy--Schwarz. A finite argument handles $n=6$. The same identity extends to arbitrary deficit multisets. It gives $M_4(n,\varepsilon)\leq2n-d$ whenever $d\geq4$ is an integer and $n\geq3d-4$, and an entirely discrete asymptotic estimate \[ M_4(n,\varepsilon)\leq(\sqrt{21}-3)n+8. \] We also prove a general continuum-to-discrete theorem for the associated four-direction fractional packing problem. Applying it to the exact continuum dual certificate constructed in earlier work yields, for both colours, \[ L_{\mathrm{mono}}(n,\varepsilon)\leq\alpha n+O(1), \qquad \alpha\approx1.5768233968738, \] and hence the same upper bound for $M_4$ and for checkerboard no-three-in-line sets.

analysis.workSummary: 对棋盘单色格点的四方向容量问题用矩恒等式推出有限规模上界及离散渐近估计，并将已有连续对偶证书转为两个颜色都适用的 αn+O(1) 上界。
analysis.breakthrough: 为同日相关连续松弛工作补上严格离散应用，α 约为 1.5768234。
analysis.limitations: 四方向容量约束弱于所有方向无三点共线；得到的是上界而非相应大小构造。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 转移机制比单个网格结果更值得关注，适合离散几何与优化读者。
